FE-3 CRITICAL: Mode drawer server error handling - Error message displayed with roll count (18) and owner (KSC), drawer stayed open after error (not silently closed), warning message shows 'terkurung', include owners checkbox fixes issue
FE-4: Create new warehouse - Default mode is 'Khusus' with entity label, warehouse created successfully (wh_428b9f79c749), badge shows 'Khusus KSC', warehouse deactivated for cleanup

FE-6b NEW: Products without price - No-price hint banner shows '3 produk', all 3 grey/sisa products (BNG-KTN-SISA, GREY-KTN-SISA, GREY-KTN-001) show 'belum ditetapkan' instead of 'Rp 0', badge shows 'Belum ada harga' instead of 'Global'

FE-7: Set price then revert - Set price modal shows global price and HPP, entered Rp 171.000, price diff shown correctly, row updated to 'Badan usaha ini' Rp 171.000, reverted to 'ikut global' Rp 165.000 with 'Global' badge
FE-8: History, filter, export - History modal shows records with status (Berlaku/Nonaktif), filter by override shows exactly 4 rows for Kanda, export button works without errors
FE-9: Different prices per entity - Switched to KSC, prod_batik_mega shows 'ikut global' Rp 185.000 with 'Global' badge, prod_ulos_batak shows entity price Rp 335.000 with 'Badan usaha ini' badge
FE-10a: Regression - No 'Warehouse' tab or create button in admin settings (correctly removed)
FE-10b: Regression - 'Semua Entitas' mode shows read-only banner with quick-pick buttons for KSC and Kanda
FE-10c: Regression - No RED console errors detected throughout all tests
FE-11a NEW: Deep-link without entity - ?view=pricelist lands on Pricelist view (not homepage)
FE-11b NEW: URL updates on navigation - Clicking menu items updates URL to ?view=<viewId>
FE-11c NEW: Page reload preserves view - Reloading page stays on same view with URL preserved
